Secret Rare.name: Athena
Secret Rare.desc: If another Fairy monster(s) is Summoned: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up Fairy monster you control to the GY, except "Athena", then target 1 Fairy monster in your GY, except "Athena"; Special Summon that target.

Secret Rare.name: Carrierroid
Secret Rare.desc: When an opponent activates a card's effect that targets and destroys a Spell or Trap Card(s) you control, you can discard 1 card to negate its activation and destroy the card.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Heat
Secret Rare.desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" monster you control.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Inferno
Secret Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Heat" + "Elemental HERO Lady Heat"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If this card battles a WATER monster, this card gains 1000 ATK during the Damage Step only.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Knospe
Secret Rare.desc: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: It gains 100 ATK and loses 100 DEF. While you control another face-up "Elemental HERO" monster, your opponent cannot target this card for an attack, and this card can attack your opponent directly.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Lady Heat
Secret Rare.desc: During each of your End Phases: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Poison Rose
Secret Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Rose Bud" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: It gains 200 ATK and loses 200 DEF. Your opponent can only target "Elemental HERO Poison Rose" for attacks.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Terra Firma
Secret Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Ocean" + "Elemental HERO Woodsman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can Tribute 1 face-up "Elemental HERO" monster; this card gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's ATK, until the End Phase.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Voltic
Secret Rare.desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 of your banished "Elemental HERO" monsters; Special Summon that target.

Secret Rare.name: Elemental HERO Woodsman
Secret Rare.desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

Secret Rare.name: Evil Dragon Ananta
Secret Rare.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play all Reptile-Type monsters from your side of the field and Graveyard. This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of monsters you removed x 600. During each of your End Phases, destroy 1 card on the field.

Secret Rare.name: Hecatrice
Secret Rare.desc: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen" from your Deck to your hand.

Secret Rare.name: HERO's Bond
Secret Rare.desc: If there is a face-up "HERO" monster on the field: Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower "Elemental HERO" monsters from your hand.

Secret Rare.name: Mezuki
Secret Rare.desc: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

Secret Rare.name: Rose Bud
Secret Rare.desc: Tribute 1 "Elemental HERO Knospe"; Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO Poison Rose" from your hand or Deck.

Secret Rare.name: Sengenjin
Secret Rare.desc: An unstoppable savage that carries Millennium Items.

Secret Rare.name: Super War-Lion
Secret Rare.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "War-Lion Ritual".

Secret Rare.name: Terra Firma Gravity
Secret Rare.desc: During your opponent's Battle Phase, if you control "Elemental HERO Terra Firma": This turn, all Level 4 or lower monsters your opponent controls that can attack a face-up "Elemental HERO Terra Firma" you control must attack it, and cannot otherwise attack.

Secret Rare.name: Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen
Secret Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

Secret Rare.name: War-Lion Ritual
Secret Rare.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Super War-Lion". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 7 or more.
